# macOS Gotchas

> Known macOS patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Permission readiness can skip a required restart](permission-readiness-skips-required-restart.md): Returning on an empty missing-permission list skips a final Screen Recording restart; track initially missing grants and process transitions before readiness. HIGH.

- [Unified log NDJSON includes completion and loss records](unified-log-ndjson-completion-and-loss.md): Recognize the completion summary and retain loss events before advancing monitoring cursors or accepting zero matches as healthy. HIGH.
- [Closing an infostealer incident does not undo the credential theft](infostealer-resolved-without-credential-rotation.md): Removing an AMOS-style LaunchAgent leaves every browser-saved password, cookie and keychain item stolen; rotate all of them from a clean device before resolving. HIGH.
- [Permission setup can outlive a startup credential](permission-setup-outlives-startup-credential.md): Human TCC approval and restart can outlast a short-lived connection token; exchange the unused startup proof once under live session authority after setup. HIGH.
- [A sleeping display is not active, so ScreenCaptureKit lists no displays](sleeping-display-not-active-screencapturekit.md): With the screen off, SCShareableContent returns zero displays; declare kIOPMUserActiveLocal activity to wake it and retry only the empty list. HIGH.
